description: Use your phone as your PC's microphone, headphones and webcam over Wi-Fi
notes: This is the PC half of phoneset. The other half is the iPhone app: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828815833
The phone's microphone needs the free VB-CABLE driver: https://vb-audio.com/Cable/
Start it with 'phoneset' (shows a QR code), or in the background with 'phoneset daemon'. Update it with 'scoop update phoneset'.
